input.summary: Kestrel ANGB janitorial services (W912KS-27-Q-0006), Attachment 3 PWS Appendix B, scanned and conformed thru Amendment 0001. Registered all 22 rows of APP-B: 21 in scope totaling 130,295 SF estimated cleaning area (matches the revised printed total), plus FAC 141 Fuels Management Office struck through and deleted by AMD 0001 (demolished). AMD 0001 pen & ink changes applied: FAC 160 revised 10,350 -> 11,020 SF; FAC 185 Small Arms Range Classroom (1,320 SF, 1X/WK) added. No grounds, dining workload or incumbent information in the package.
unresolved: Area column is 'EST. SQ FT (CLEANING AREA)' only; no gross building area is printed, so the cleaning area was recorded as both gross and cleanable area (e.g. FAC 125 hangar covers office/latrine/break room/stairwell only; FAC 155 admin & latrines only).
Attachment 4 floor plans (15 pages) referenced in B.1 and the footnote are not in the package.
UTA frequency (once per Unit Training Assembly weekend, normally one weekend per month) mapped to monthly for FAC 110 and 115; FAC 106 is 1X/WK plus each UTA weekend, mapped to weekly.
No contract period, location, climate, grounds or previous/incumbent contract data in the package.
